_meta: Freedom resources. Curriculum by Church of the Highlands (freely available). Weekly reflections are MIRAGE's own, keyed to the current week by the page. Links verified 2026-09-06.

reflections.verse: It is for freedom that Christ has set us free.
reflections.thought: We begin where the whole journey is headed: not toward trying harder, but toward walking free. Come as you are.

reflections.verse: You will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.
reflections.thought: Freedom starts with honesty. The thing we won't name is the thing that keeps its grip.

reflections.verse: Where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is freedom.
reflections.thought: This isn't willpower work. Freedom is a Person's presence, not a private achievement.

reflections.verse: There is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.
reflections.thought: Shame says clean yourself up first. Grace says come now, and be changed here.

reflections.verse: You are my hiding place; you surround me with songs of deliverance.
reflections.thought: A marriage grows safe when both people have somewhere safe to be fully known.

reflections.verse: He has sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim freedom for the captives.
reflections.thought: The old wounds we carry into marriage were never meant to stay chained. This is the week to name one.

reflections.verse: The Lord is close to the brokenhearted and saves the crushed in spirit.
reflections.thought: Nearness, not distance, is God's response to our lowest places. Let each other in this week.

reflections.verse: Put off your old self and put on the new self, created to be like God.
reflections.thought: Freedom has two motions: setting something down, and picking something better up.

reflections.verse: Do not be anxious about anything; the peace of God will guard your hearts.
reflections.thought: Anxiety is a lonely weight. Carried together and given up in prayer, it lightens.

reflections.verse: Be transformed by the renewing of your mind.
reflections.thought: The stories we believe about ourselves and each other can be rewritten. That is real work, and it is worth it.

reflections.verse: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us.
reflections.thought: Confession is not the end of dignity; it is the start of freedom. Nearly there now.

reflections.verse: If anyone is in Christ, the new creation has come: the old has gone, the new is here.
reflections.thought: Twelve weeks in, look back at who you were. Then keep walking. The conference is where it all leads.
